newsitem.title: USA: Ralston Purina pet products' profit up.
newsitem.headline: Ralston Purina pet products' profit up.

text.p: Ralston Purina Co said its pet products' operating profit increased in the fiscal fourth quarter as higher volume more than offset significantly higher pet food ingredient costs.
To a lesser extent, profits were helped by pricing and an improved product mix.

Ralston said its battery products operating profit increased in the quarter on strong peformance in the Asia/Pacific region, as well as in the United States where Energizer's new alkaline on-battery tester quickly achieved national distribution.
However, these gains were substantially offset by lower rechargeable battery sales to original equipment manufacturers and declines in Europe.
Soy protein products' operating profit decreased in the quarter as higher raw material costs and business development spending offset volume gains and increased prices, Ralston said.
Results for individual segments were not given.
Earlier, Ralston reported operating earnings for the fourth quarter ended September 30 of $1.00 a primary share, up from $0.72 a year ago.
